text:
anya: Quick check — light drizzle + a slowdown over the Dumbarton this AM, added ~25m to my commute. Anyone else heading eastbound?

mike: Ugh same. 84 was basically a parking lot between the Newark exit and the bridge. Took the 880 detour and still crawled. :coffee:

jia: I saw a stalled truck pin on Waze near the express lanes, prob why. 🤦‍♀️

leo: I'm remote today but thinking of swinging by to grab an umbrella from the office stash if it's still there. Anyone keep that bin maintained?

nora: Yup the lobby bin is alive — I restocked two collapsibles last week. Left a little sticky note that says "redwood" so neighbors don't abscond with them. :trophy:

anya: Legend nora. Saved my shoes this morning. If anyone's coming to Mission later, I can drop one off.

sam: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/cat-rain (mood)

deploy-bot: Heads-up: oncall rotation change deployed at 07:20. Not related to traffic but posting here in case someone needs a heads up. :robot_face:

mike: @jia mind dropping the Waze link? Want to see exact spot for the stalled truck.

jia: sure — https://waze.com/ul?ll=37.5290,-122.0340&navigate=yes

leo: Thinking about switching to Caltrain tomorrow if this keeps up. Anyone tried the 9:05 from Mountain View lately?

anya: Caltrain had a 12m delay earlier but was roomy. Could be a dryer option if you don't mind the schedule.

nora: Quick poll — react with an emoji for where you're coming from today: :car: East Bay, :bridge: SF, :train: Peninsula, :house_with_garden: Remote

sam: :car: (East Bay)

anya: thanks everyone — stay dry out there. :umbrella:

(threads like this are short, feel free to ping #commute if you want live updates)
